stage: Expected interaction behavior for all alternatives; unexecuted
form_identity: Stable owning form instance/route/row identity; separate simultaneous forms do not share request or selection state.
Lookup context includes current authenticated actor/team/grant context, owning form instance and canonical parent reference/revision; no ambient implicit input capture.
input_absence: Initial absent parent disables/unsets dependent child and performs no lookup.
Only typed canonical partial values feed mapped read parameters; invalid/incomplete values show correctable validation and do not execute final mutation.
No dependency cycle; only declared prerequisites are read; no mutation operation can supply choices.
change_and_results: Parent change invalidates old lookup and incompatible child immediately; preserve unrelated notes/street/file/reason/email/due drafts.
Abort/debounce is a cost/lifecycle control, not authority. Context+sequence fencing discards old responses even if cancellation fails.

For a picker-supplied child, retain selection when returned and eligible under exactly same current parent/context; otherwise clear it. Approval original unassisted opaque user path remains available, and empty viewer choices never creates a new final candidate-membership guard. Parent switch clears incompatible choice while lookup pending.
Pending result cannot restore a cleared child. Empty authorized result and read error are distinct; no global broad-candidate fallback.
A denied/stale result carries no leaked candidates; refresh/repair may rerun same existing read, not automatically submit final mutation.
authority: Every lookup and every final submission rechecks current identity/membership/record+field grants; no candidate result confers role/site/work or capacity authority.

Final actual canonical envelope/schema/business guards and current reference revisions remain mandatory, including relation match, actual reviewer role, distinct assignee and current workplace eligibility.
MCP uses the same final operation/schema/current guards; it need not emulate a browser partial draft or first perform candidate lookup.
ui: Loading/empty/error/disabled child clearly presented with EN/NL captions and current selection.
Keyboard selection, focus after invalidation/error, accessible announced updates and modal focus remain stable; preserve current unsaved unrelated fields.
Reopen/reconnect refetches authorized state and cannot submit/create/reserve automatically.
source_limits: Original CanApprove lookup is bound to persisted Document and duplicates canonical candidate-bound forms; no partial country-like sibling input exists there.
Current nested forms can expose a staged selection workflow; automatic partial-draft cancellation/clearing/focus behavior is not established by source alone.
Proposed checked metadata centralizes controller responsibility; runtime/adoption advantage remains hypothetical until comparable browser checks.
